When evaluating 3-character strings that did not match `'y'` or `'Y'` (such as `"tru"`), execution inadvertently fell through into `case 4`, which attempted to index character 3 (`str.charAt(3)`), resulting in a `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException`.

### Changes Made
- In [`BooleanUtils.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_c_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/BooleanUtils.java#L682), added `return false;` at the end of `case 3:` to prevent unintentional fallthrough into `case 4:`.
